```  
Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more modified polyisocyanates that can include 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS).  

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.  

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one modified polyisocyanate derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate.  

Claim 4 (Original): The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.  

Claim 5 (Original): A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.  

Claim 6 (Original): A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.  

Claim 7 (Original): The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.  

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is defined as greater than 200 nm, as measured by root mean square roughness.  
```
